caption: The drawing consists of six stylized plant motifs, each labeled as a figure from FIG. 1 to FIG. 6, arranged in a grid of two rows and three columns. The background is a textured light brown, resembling parchment or aged paper. The motifs are painted in shades of blue and black, occasionally highlighted with lighter blue or white. FIG. 1 (top left) depicts a tree with a single trunk and numerous evenly spaced, upward-arching branches, flanked on each side by curved leaf-like shapes. FIG. 2 (top right) has an abstract, flower-like or feathered form with bold, rounded and pointed segments, adorned with a series of small circular blue dots extending in a curve. FIG. 3 (middle left) features three petal-shaped forms with central dark dots, surrounded by elongated, curved leaves, all decorated with clusters of small dots. FIG. 4 (middle right) displays clustered, layered petal shapes, with a few smaller leaves and rounded forms attached to the central stem. FIG. 5 (bottom left) shows a single stem with a central rounded bloom bearing black dots, accompanied by curled leaf-like structures extending along the lower edge. FIG. 6 (bottom right) presents an undulating, segmented object with multiple bulbous forms connected in a row, accented by a sweeping curved base. The overall composition uses varying shades and layers of blue as the primary color palette, with details defined by strong, dark lines and dot patterns.
title: Decoration for Stoneware
